articles.title: Wells Fargo and five others object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock listings: Report
articles.snippet: As of Friday, 22 companies had filed objections as part of the joint venture’s proposed tokenized stock platform under the SEC’s innovation exemption.

articles.title: SpaceX Filing Gives Elon Musk the Final Word on Tesla Merger He Says He’s Staying Out Of
articles.snippet: SpaceX’s latest 10-Q filing quietly confirms any Tesla combination requires sign-off from its “controlling shareholder.”
